in_greek.name: Σηρεινη
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word 'sēros', meaning 'new', 'fresh', 'clear', or 'shining'. It could be interpreted as 'new woman', 'fresh woman', or 'shining woman'.

in_latin.name: Scholastica
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the word 'scholastica', meaning 'learned' or 'scholarly'. It may be derived from the Greek name 'Scheria', which also means 'new' or 'fresh'.
